subject: S22: prune covers sync_ops (24 h) and sync_tombstones (90 d); SW needs already met
body: naadi.prune.daily deletes public.sync_ops older than 24 h and public.sync_tombstones older than 90 days by created_at (each guarded by to_regclass, so it is a no-op until 0023 is applied). No gc.py needed on your side. CSP already has worker-src 'self', and connect-src includes the Supabase project origin (https + wss), so the SW's fetch of content-public figures is allowed; nothing to add. Thanks for keeping every route behind a limiter: tests/test_rate_limit_audit.py will check them once you land.
